public_body: Barnstable Whelden Memorial Library Board Of Trustees
overall: The AG found the Whelden Memorial Library trustee board is not a public body under the OML because the government did not create or structure it, so the notice, access, and minutes allegations were not reached and bylaw claims were declined.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the library trustee board violated the OML; the Board responded that it is not a public body subject to the law.
Complainant alleged the Board failed to post notice of its monthly meetings.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Whelden Memorial Library fails to meet the first element of the first factor.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged she was told the monthly meeting was closed to the public and was asked to leave.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Whelden Memorial Library fails to meet the first element of the first factor.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board did not maintain minutes of its meetings in accordance with the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the Whelden Memorial Library fails to meet the first element of the first factor.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board violated its bylaws, including by operating with fewer members than the bylaws require.
allegations.key_passage: The Division of Open Government enforces the Open Meeting Law only and takes no position relative to the Board’s conformance with other laws or rules.
